name: Family Holidays
heading: A holiday that works for everyone coming along.
introduction: Beach days, busy days and time together, with the practical details thought through.
closing_heading: Have a family trip in mind?
closing_body: Tell me who is coming, when you can travel and what would make the holiday work for you.

name: Cruises
heading: New to cruising? Start with the kind of days you would enjoy.
introduction: Get to know the choices, from UK departures to river journeys and fly-cruises.
image_alt: Gentle ocean waves beneath a pale sky
closing_heading: Ready to talk through a cruise?
closing_body: Tell me what appeals, what you are unsure about and whether you have particular dates or departure preferences.

name: Couples Escapes
heading: Time away together, in a way that suits you both.
introduction: A quiet base, a busy city or a few days away — it need not mean a luxury retreat.
image_alt: Modern white villa with a sunlit swimming pool
closing_body: Share your ideas, dates and comfortable budget when you are ready to take the next step.

name: City Breaks
heading: Choose a base that makes the city easier to enjoy.
introduction: Look beyond hotel stars to the neighbourhood, journey and time you have to explore.
image_alt: Historic European city architecture beside a canal
closing_heading: Have a city or a few dates in mind?
closing_body: Tell me what you would like to see and how you prefer to spend your days.

name: Something Different
heading: Start with an idea, rather than a familiar holiday format.
introduction: Rail, touring, nature or several stops: explore a different way to spend your time away.
image_alt: Mountain landscape stretching into the distance
closing_heading: Have an idea you would like to explore?
closing_body: Tell me what interests you and I can research the possibilities and the practical arrangements.

name: Accessible Travel
heading: Start with what works for you, then check the details.
introduction: Individual requirements, practical questions and specific supplier confirmation.
image_alt: Open coastal landscape beside calm water; illustrative destination photograph
closing_heading: Would you like to discuss what you need?
closing_body: Use the Holiday Brief to indicate that there are requirements to talk through privately. Detailed medical information is not needed there.
